stories.title: Sources: Rams star Garrett to have knee surgery, headed to IR
stories.summary: Rams star defensive end Myles Garrett will undergo knee surgery and is headed to injured reserve, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Manning delivers in 4th as Texas stuns Ohio State in 20-point comeback
stories.summary: Arch Manning helped Texas overcome a 23-3 fourth-quarter deficit, leading scoring drives of 15, 13 and 12 plays as the Longhorns stunned No. 1 Ohio State 24-23.

stories.title: Sources: Crosby shut down Rams trade talks, wanted to stay with Raiders
stories.summary: The Rams pursued Maxx Crosby shortly after his trade from the Raiders to the Ravens fell through, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Steelers star Porter inactive for opener amid uncertain Pittsburgh future
stories.summary: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., who has been embroiled in a contract dispute all summer, will not play against the Falcons because of a back injury, and the possibility of a trade remains in play.

stories.title: Final pitch: Tigers, retiring Verlander aim for one last start
stories.summary: Justin Verlander is progressing in his return from a hamstring injury with he and the Tigers hoping he can make one last start during a planned two-day celebration of the retiring former ace.
